Caldera Senior Lecturer of Business Administration Senior Lecturer of Business Administration Louis Caldera is a Senior Lecturer of Business Administration at Harvard Business School. He teaches Leadership and Corporate Accountability, a required first-year course in the MBA program. He has previously taught law school courses on corporate governance and legislative and democratic process, and his interests include strengthening democratic institutions, increasing economic opportunity, and building climate resilience.
